For fixed y∈F: (x-y)² ≥ c(2x+2y+c) ≥ c(2y+c) ⇒ |x-y| ≥ √(c(2y+c)) > 0 for all x∈C, so F is open. (0,∞) connected cannot be disjoint union of two nonempty open sets. The lower bounds are strict because c>0, x,y>0. No uniformity assumption needed; pointwise openness suffices. The step 'c(2x+2y+c) ≥ c(2x+c)' uses y>0 correctly (not y≥0, since domain is ℝ>0).
